verdict.rationale: Restate's docs say you can operate Restate yourself. It ships as a single self-contained binary with no external dependencies that runs single- or multi-node clusters on a local machine, a VM or Kubernetes, and there is a dedicated self-hosted overview. A community comment criticizes the BSL license, but that concerns licensing terms, not whether self-hosting works. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted production deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can use Restate Cloud, run a managed Restate region in your cloud account with Restate BYOC, or operate Restate yourself.

Restate is distributed as a single binary that implements all features required to run a single- or multi-node cluster, making it easy to run it on a variety of platforms, from your local machine, to a VM, to Kubernetes.
Restate is a single self-contained binary. No external dependencies needed.
